about: Areas of a 1080x1920 frame covered by each app's interface, as fractions of the frame. safe_zone and buttons: covered on an ordinary post (red on the sheet). ads_zone: the platform's published ad template, which also covers long captions and ad add-ons (amber). Every app changes its interface and phones differ: treat a hit as a warning to check in the app, never as a certainty. Each number names its source; update it with a new source when a layout ships.

covered_by.bottom: the caption, the sound and the progress bar
covered_by.right: the profile, like, comment, save and share buttons

sources.max_seconds: upload from the phone app (60 min); 10 min when recorded in the app; viewgum/short-form-video-specs
